description: Bela Automotives Limited manufactures automotive parts, precision cold-forged components and bicycle parts, including high-tensile bolts, nuts, studs, screws and gear shafts, at its registered office and factory at Mouza Pathra, Hub Chowki in Balochistan. The company was incorporated as a private limited company in November 1983 and converted to a public limited company in August 1985.
headOffice: Plot No. 1 & 3, Mouza Pathra, Hub Chowki, Balochistan, Pakistan
